correctness.rationale: Write X=A+epsilon B, so A^2=0 and AB+BA=0 in any characteristic. Rank-r A has r length-two Jordan blocks and s=n-2r zero blocks. Diagonal P reversing the image block sign satisfies PA=-AP, including char 2, so anti-commutator fibers biject with the commutant of A, dimension (n-r)^2+r^2. The reductions are counted by choosing image U subset kernel K and an isomorphism F_q^n/K to U: [n choose r]_q[n-r choose r]_q |GL_r|=q^(2r(n-r)) Phi_n/(Phi_r Phi_(n-2r)). Multiplication cancels exponent to n^2. Uniform exponential estimates Phi_m-Phi_infty=O_q(q^-m) imply rank weights differ from 1/Phi_infty by a summable boundary term, yielding total O_q(1) remainder and O_q(1/n) empirical CDF error. Endpoints r=0 and n=1 valid. Fresh exhaustive anticommutator kernel ranks checked F2 n<=3 and F3 n<=2.
